inputs.text: Job Sikhala is right to urge people to reject proposed constitutional amendments reportedly designed to extend Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. Calling public opposition “posturing” and putting stability above political rights risks treating the public’s voice as a threat while ignoring the stakes of changing rules that limit executive power. A lawful process matters, but it must be genuinely open and accountable—not a shield for those already in power.
